scientific_integrity: Exact factorization and root count were checked symbolically and proved by Descartes’ rule and sign changes. The day-verified 2006-06-01 date comes from the original arXiv submission. Earlier historical publications are known by year but no reliable exact first-public day was established; no assertion of independent certification or complete historical exclusivity.
scientific_limitations: Complete census only for primitive period two and all real \(\mu\) in the indicated conservative rational planar family; no classification of higher-period points, stability multipliers, or nonperiodic invariant sets. The 1980 monograph and a 1985 historical article were not available in full text; historical duplication remains a literature risk.
title: Two primitive two-cycles below a sharp threshold in the conservative Gumowski–Mira map
